how_to_freeze: Owner validates in issue #212, then a commit sets status FROZEN, fills owner_validation (comment URL) and keeps digest equal to registry_digest(thresholds). compare-series refuses any other status and any divergent CLI override.

rationale.max_missing_rate: PROPOSED 10 % of the seconds of the compared range with no usable point on at least one side. Motivated: a 1-second-of-2 gap is 50 % and must fail; sparse grid-sampled series legitimately miss some seconds, 10 % keeps >= 90 % of the range comparable. Not derived from data: the owner must validate or change it before freezing.
rationale.min_compared: 1000 seconds : sample size named in the plan.
